verdict_basis: No unresolved material factual error, contradictory instruction, or important omission was identified within the specified base-game scope. This is a source audit of the frozen candidate; it is not a reader-performance result.

important_omissions_assessment.result: No material omission found within this summary’s scope. Numerical board-track costs, VP and bonuses are intentionally referenced to the faction boards rather than transcribed; this matches how the supplied Law specifies those quantities. Card-specific crafted-effect text is likewise deferred to cards under precedence. The applicable FAQs are represented explicitly or through unambiguous common/faction procedures.

source_observations.detail: Publisher rendered text omits item glyphs in 5.1.5 and much of chapter 9 and Appendix V. Native PDF renders resolve all in-scope item identities.

Rendered body lacks standalone 1.3.3 Consent; raw link array contains that anchor and the publisher consent FAQs supply the same rule. Native October 13, 2025 PDF 1.3.3 explicitly states Actions never require consent.

The duplicate Charismatic-shortage FAQ appears following 7.8.3 Commander in the supplied rendered text. Its question explicitly names Charismatic, consistent with native Law 7.8.2. This is an attachment oddity, not a rule conflict.

Publisher text and PDF have some expansion-only wording/appendix-number differences (for example Gorge bridge description and Components appendix organization). These were read but do not alter any scoped candidate claim.

candidate.literal_read: Entire 287-line frozen candidate delivered in two contiguous sed responses (1–200 and 201–400; second reaches EOF).

extracted_law.literal_read: All 3185 lines, including excluded sections and index/credits, delivered and read in bounded contiguous sed responses.

publisher_rendered_text.literal_read: All 2019 TXT lines delivered and read, including complete Law and FAQ prose, not just FAQ excerpts.

publisher_structure.logical_structure_inspected: Raw wrapper/metadata/link array plus complete decoded text value. One results object and empty errors array. Inspected URL, final_url, title, description, language, author=null, published_date=null, all 814 links, latency_ms, format=markdown, and complete page_metadata including og/other.
publisher_structure.raw_text_line_limit: An initial sed 1–12 attempt included the single very long escaped JSON text line and was truncated (33819 tokens vs 3000 budget). This is not claimed as complete raw byte/literal delivery. The complete text value was actually read from TXT; exact programmatic comparison establishes equivalence of that value, not raw-wrapper delivery. Raw wrapper and every link were separately actually delivered.
publisher_structure.other_truncation_repair: An initial 10–430 link read was truncated (10555 vs 10000 token budget); all its content was reread in smaller complete bounded ranges.
publisher_structure.metadata_caution: URL and source-provenance establish supplied snapshot identity; generic site metadata lacks an independent edition date. The PDF cover supplies the specified edition. No live refresh performed.

provenance.limitations: Source-only provenance contains hashes, scope, URL and retrieved_date 2026-11-05; it does not independently verify the remote retrieval process. Hashes recomputed and match all listed inputs.

native_pdf.text_method: PyMuPDF page.get_text() with native order, saved per physical page; no text filtering or unseen excerpts substituted for full pages.
native_pdf.image_delivery: Each listed image was passed through tools.view_image and its returned image_url forwarded using image(), producing an actual image tool response. Saved filenames alone are not treated as delivery evidence.

limits: No source outside the explicit whitelist was read. No live publisher browsing, card-library lookup or faction-board images were used.
All 32 native page texts were read, but only the 16 listed pages were rendered and actually viewed. Excluded expansion graphics were not visually audited.

Raw JSON escaped text line was not completely received as a single literal escaped line; its complete decoded text was read through the exactly equivalent TXT. All raw nontext fields and link-array entries were actually received in bounded chunks.

Frontmatter BGG ID, commercial play-time/player-count labels and historical verification/summarization dates are not established as independent external facts by this rules-source audit; PASS concerns material rules accuracy within the requested scope.
A summary is not a full replacement for cards/faction-board track printing. No independent evidence beyond the supplied sources is claimed.
